outcome: Cumulative survival at 28 days after birth
cohort: 213 fetuses diagnosed prenatally with isolated left-sided congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH)
finding: Delivery between 37 + 0 and 38 + 6 weeks' gestation is associated with a higher survival rate at 28 days in neonates with isolated left-sided CDH and moderate lung hypoplasia.
